brief: Red-orange common-brick silo about 14 ft across and 36 ft high, laid in running bond with a scatter of darker overburnt bricks and a faint iron ladder up one side, open at the top with no roof. It stands joined to a slightly shorter twin, and a roofless ruin of a low brick feed room with a log lintel over its doorway clings to their base. Alone in open sagebrush range behind a buck-and-rail fence, with pronghorn in the grass and blue mountains beyond.
